audit.whatIsWrong: The stored level chart disagreed with the packet chart at five of seven rows, and at three of those it also contradicted the page's own whys text.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Akali, Akali, Skill]. whys[1] and whys[2] describe level 2 and level 3 as Renekton's strongest windows (chart said Skill/Akali); whys[3] says neither side closes a kill at 4-5 (chart said Akali); whys[4] says Perfect Execution negates the Dominus window (chart said Renekton 7/10); whys[6] says she wins the 1v1 but you win the fight (chart said Akali). The packet chart agrees with the prose everywhere.
audit.corrected: phases[1..4].side and phases[6].side realigned to the packet chart with win[1..4] and win[6] flipped in the same atomic group, ratings adjusted, and phases[4].why / phases[6].why rewritten so the reasoning matches the new owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed 'Dominus stats turn even fights into wins' at the exact level where Perfect Execution comes online.
audit.why: Akali's R is a two-part cast — a leap, then a re-cast dash that executes — on 120/90/60s. It out-scales the level-6 Dominus window, which is why the packet gives level 6 to Akali.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Perfect Execution, its 120s rank-1 cooldown, and the R1-bait / W-stun-the-follow-up sequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark, the auto-attack reset that opens her burst, appeared nowhere on the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'autoreset-burst-tell'. Riot's text: dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring around them; exiting that ring empowers her next attack with bonus range and damage. The ring exit, not her ability cast, is the disengage cue — and the bonus range means backing up inside her ring range does not save you.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] now reads 'Leave her ring after a spell so Assassin's Mark resets her auto with bonus range'.
sources: enemyKit P text and autoReset flag

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text, whys[5] and wants.foe[2] all reference an Akali item called 'Night's Edge'.
audit.why: No such item appears in League; the kit files carry no item data and I could not verify it. Rather than substitute a guessed item, only the spike was rewritten around Hextech Rocketbelt, which is genuinely an Akali item, and the rest is recorded as unverified.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text rebuilt on Hextech Rocketbelt plus Perfect Execution's 120s timer. whys[5] and wants.foe[2] left untouched pending a ruling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged 'Pop Twilight Shroud' in wants.foe[0] as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: False positive — the distance of 4 is the leading verb 'Pop'. Twilight Shroud is the real W name, and the untargetability claim in that line matches Riot's text exactly.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is two dashes and an execute on a 120s timer — it beats Dominus, so bait R1, then W-stun the second cast.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: She wins the side-lane 1v1; you win the fight. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — W-stun her off your carry instead of duelling her.

edits.before: Full Hextech Rocketbelt or Night's Edge Akali bursts you through your HP bar — avoid hard commits unless you are significantly ahead and she has no R charges.
edits.after: Two-item Akali with Hextech Rocketbelt bursts through your HP bar — avoid hard commits unless you are well ahead and Perfect Execution is still on its 120s timer.

edits.before: Kite you off your Q heal with E-shuriken poke, draining your HP before she all-ins
edits.after: Leave her ring after a spell so Assassin's Mark resets her auto with bonus range

notes: The level chart on disk disagreed with the packet chart at five rows and with the page's own prose at three — corrected as one atomic group across both layers. 'Night's Edge' is not a League item and appears in whys[5] and wants.foe[2] as well as the spike I rewrote; I could not verify what it was meant to be, so those two were left alone. Renekton's empowered W shield-destruction is a non-interaction here (Akali has no shield) — the mirror audit reached the same conclusion and neither side asserts it. Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable by spells and attacks, so a targeted W whiffs, but Slice and Dice is a direction dash and still passes through it.
